technicals.price_basis: close (not dividend-adjusted); same basis used for daily high/low

sma20.method: Arithmetic mean of the latest 20 completed session closes.

sma50.method: Arithmetic mean of the latest 50 completed session closes.

sma200.method: Arithmetic mean of the latest 200 completed session closes.

rsi14.method: Wilder RSI: 14-change SMA seed, then 1/14 smoothing. All-flat series uses the explicit neutral convention 50.

macd.method: EMA(12) minus EMA(26); each EMA starts with its period's SMA.

macd_signal.method: EMA(9) of valid MACD values, seeded with their SMA.

volume_average20.method: Mean volume of the prior 20 completed sessions, excluding the session being measured.

volume_ratio20.method: Latest completed session volume / prior 20-session mean volume. Unavailable when the denominator is zero.

high52w.method: Highest daily high within the trailing 52 calendar weeks.

low52w.method: Lowest daily low within the trailing 52 calendar weeks.

next_earnings_date.reason: Provider dates may change; a window is not collapsed to one exact date.

fundamentals.as_of_note: Retrieval time is not a financial statement publication date. Reporting periods and forward estimates are identified per field.

data.disclaimer: Not financial advice. Indicators describe observed data; no score or recommendation.
